facts.fact: Decree 148/PR/2026 of 23 March 2026 promulgated Law 003/AN-SENAT/2026 ratifying Ordinance 001/PR/2026 of 22 January 2026 reforming ANSICE and widening its powers, per the government's general secretariat.

systems.system: ANSICE (Agence nationale de sécurité informatique et de certification électronique)
